login.ok.evidence: Login Form block page 1887 (redirectUrl set): alice with a temporary known password submits the real form and lands on /qa-rft-login-landing/ logged in. Original password hash restored afterwards (verified identical).

login.wrong.evidence: Elementor widget (AJAX): unknown user and wrong password both give 'The username or password is incorrect. Please try again.' Block form posts to wp-login.php (LearnDash off via qa_off): core's own messages ('The username X is not registered...' vs 'The password you entered for the username alice is incorrect.'), the error shows and nothing else leaks. Per the reworded check that is WordPress core, informational. LearnDash-on variant (?login=failed, no message) not re-walked.

login.lockout.evidence: Elementor widget: attempts 1-3 normal message, 4th onward 'Too many login attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.' (DB transient count 12, locked_until set); transient deleted afterwards.
